Buddhist Ghost Festival (Ullambana)

Buddhist Ghost Festival (Ullambana) Observance at Home

Celebrate the Buddhist Ghost Festival by honoring ancestors and comforting wandering spirits through meaningful rituals and traditional vegetarian offerings.

  1. Morning

    Prepare Offerings

    Begin the day by preparing simple vegetarian dishes, fresh fruit, and tea to present as offerings, symbolizing respect and nourishment for ancestors and spirits.

    Recipes: Buddhist Vegetarian Stir-Fry · Sweet Sticky Rice with Fruit · Traditional Brewed Tea

  2. Late Morning

    Set Up Altar and Offerings

    Arrange the prepared food, incense, and paper lanterns on a home altar or special area to invite and comfort the spirits during the festival.

    Recipes: Buddhist Vegetarian Stir-Fry · Sweet Sticky Rice with Fruit · Traditional Brewed Tea

  3. Noon

    Offer Incense and Prayers

    Light incense sticks and offer prayers or silent reflections for ancestors and hungry ghosts, fostering a sense of connection and compassion.

  4. Afternoon

    Visit Local Temple or Virtual Ceremony

    If possible, visit a nearby temple to participate in communal rituals or join a virtual ceremony to deepen your observance.

  5. Late Afternoon

    Family Sharing and Storytelling

    Gather with family to share stories of ancestors and reflect on their lives, strengthening family bonds and remembrance.

  6. Evening

    Enjoy a Festive Vegetarian Meal

    Sit down together to enjoy the vegetarian dishes prepared earlier, appreciating the symbolic significance of the meal in honoring the spirits.

    Recipes: Buddhist Vegetarian Stir-Fry · Fragrant Sticky Rice with Lotus Seeds · Sweet Sticky Rice with Fruit · Traditional Brewed Tea

  7. Sundown

    Light Lanterns and Paper Offerings

    Light lanterns or set out paper offerings outside to guide and comfort wandering spirits as night falls, symbolizing hope and peace.

End the day with a moment of quiet reflection, feeling connected to your ancestors and the community of spirits around you.
